step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram from Ashok Leyland's iAnalytics platform illustrates a real-time and batch data processing pipeline on AWS. Streaming data from 150,000 connected vehicles enters the platform through a secure VPC endpoint via Kafka. The real-time stream is processed by a LIVE EMR cluster running Spark and HBase to calculate 18 real-time KPIs, saving raw payloads into an S3 raw data bucket. At hourly intervals, a BATCH EMR cluster reads from the raw S3 bucket, calculating 99 additional KPIs saved to a KPI S3 bucket, and compressing raw logs into Parquet format written to a PARQUET S3 bucket. Data from the KPI bucket is aggregated into Amazon Redshift for structured enterprise reporting. Data analysts run ad-hoc queries over the PARQUET S3 bucket using Amazon Athena. Machine learning engineers pull Parquet data into SageMaker to train models for real-time use cases like fuel pilferage detection. An RDS instance stores vehicle metadata, customer profiles, and geospatial mapping references.

nodes.name: VPC
nodes.notes: Secure channel through which data from third-party Kafka stream enters AWS.

nodes.name: LIVE
nodes.notes: Live EMR cluster running Spark and HBase calculating 18 KPIs in real time.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: S3 bucket storing raw real-time streaming data (~350 GB/day, retained for 120 days).

nodes.name: BATCH
nodes.notes: Batch EMR cluster running hourly Spark streams to calculate 99 KPIs and compress data.

nodes.name: PARQUET
nodes.notes: S3 bucket storing compressed historical data in Parquet format.

nodes.name: KPI
nodes.notes: S3 bucket storing calculated aggregated KPI metrics.

nodes.name: SAGEMAKER
nodes.notes: Amazon SageMaker used by data science team to train models for real-time fuel pilferage detection.

nodes.name: RDS
nodes.notes: Relational Database storing customer, vehicle metadata, and geospatial data.

nodes.name: ATHENA
nodes.notes: Amazon Athena used by data analysts to perform ad-hoc SQL queries over Parquet data.

nodes.name: REDSHIFT
nodes.notes: Amazon Redshift data warehouse storing structured aggregated analytics for enterprise reports.

edges.notes: Incoming stream from VPC is ingested into the LIVE EMR cluster.
LIVE EMR cluster writes real-time processed stream data into raw S3 bucket.
BATCH EMR cluster pulls raw data from S3 every 1 hour.
BATCH EMR converts raw data into compressed Parquet format and writes to PARQUET S3 bucket.
BATCH EMR calculates 99 KPIs and writes to KPI S3 bucket.
Aggregated KPI data is loaded from KPI bucket into Redshift data warehouse.
SageMaker pulls compressed Parquet data to train machine learning models.
Athena queries Parquet data stored in S3 directly for ad-hoc analytical reporting.
